conditions.description: The unsafe extractor joins an archive entry name directly to the destination without rejecting parent traversal components.
conditions.rationale: Entries containing ../ can escape the intended extraction root.

conditions.description: The unsafe extractor does not reject absolute archive entry paths before joining them to the extraction root.
conditions.rationale: Absolute paths can bypass the intended destination boundary.

conditions.description: The unsafe extractor uses File::create for attacker-selected targets and can overwrite an existing file reached through an unsafe path.
conditions.rationale: Path escape combined with truncating creation can destroy files outside the archive destination.

conditions.description: The unsafe extractor copies an unbounded input stream to disk with no per-entry size ceiling.
conditions.rationale: A large or decompression-expanded entry can exhaust storage resources.

conditions.description: The safe-name extractor rejects absolute paths and any component that is not a normal path component.
conditions.rationale: This is an explicit path-normalization negative control and should not be reported as traversal-prone.

conditions.description: The safe-name extractor uses create_new(true), preventing silent overwrite of an existing target.
conditions.rationale: The safe control should not be promoted to an overwrite finding.

conditions.description: Whether the production extractor runs inside an OS sandbox, container, or chroot is not established by this source file.
conditions.rationale: Filesystem confinement is an external runtime property absent from the fixture.

conditions.description: Whether all callers pre-validate archive names before invoking extract_entry is not established by the available artifact.
conditions.rationale: No complete call graph or caller contract is present.

conditions.description: The unsafe extractor must not be cleared as confined to its destination directory.
conditions.rationale: Static source shows no boundary check in extract_entry.

conditions.description: The unsafe extractor must not be cleared as resource-bounded for entry writes.
conditions.rationale: No byte ceiling is enforced in extract_entry.
